summary: DealLens AI backend re-verified after vision model reverted to gpt-5.4 and loud-fail (502 AI_PARSE_FAILED / AI_UNAVAILABLE) added. ALL 19/19 pytest tests pass (100%). CRITICAL BLOCKER FROM ITERATION_2 IS FIXED: POST /api/scan with a real product JPEG (400x400 smartwatch, /tmp/product.jpg) now returns a REAL analysis, not the fallback stub. Live probe results: image scan → name='Round Smartwatch', category='Smartwatch', deal_score=58, 3 real pros, 3 named alternatives (Galaxy Watch6, Watch SE, Venu Sq 2); text scan for 'Sony WH-1000XM5 wireless headphones' → name='Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones', category='Wireless Headphones', deal_score=90, 3 named alternatives (Bose 700, Sennheiser Momentum 4, Apple AirPods Max). Hard assertions added and passing: product_info.name != 'Product detected', category != 'General', positive_aspects >= 1, alternatives >= 1 each with non-empty name+reason. All four image-validation error codes still return HTTP 400 with correct detail (INVALID_BASE64, IMAGE_TOO_SMALL bytes, IMAGE_TOO_SMALL dimensions, CORRUPT_IMAGE). All six auth guards still return 401. Analytics event + stats unaffected. Code paths verified: AI_PARSE_FAILED exists at server.py:315 (vision) and :409 (text); AI_UNAVAILABLE exists at :319 and :415; vision model 'gpt-5.4' at :282; text model 'gpt-4o' at :390.

minor.issue: Still accepts `language: str` as a query parameter (rest of API uses JSON bodies). Also accepts arbitrary strings with no whitelist (e.g. 'zz' would be accepted). Cosmetic, not blocking.
